aboutUs.title: About MyPadiFood
aboutUs.subtitle: Breaking down language and currency barriers to empower businesses worldwide

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: We believe every business, regardless of size or location, deserves access to global customers. MyPadiFood was born from a simple observation: language and currency barriers shouldn't limit a business's potential to serve customers worldwide.
mission.point1: Enable businesses to reach customers in any language without the complexity of manual translation
mission.point2: Eliminate the friction of currency conversion and international payment processing

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: We envision a world where a small farm in Nigeria can seamlessly serve customers in Japan, a boutique in Paris can effortlessly ship to Brazil, and a restaurant in Mexico can take orders from customers in India - all without worrying about language barriers or payment complications.
vision.point1: Power over 1 million businesses globally by 2030
vision.point2: Support commerce in every language and currency worldwide

value1.title: Accessibility
value1.description: Technology should empower, not complicate. No apps to download, no complex setups.

value2.title: Innovation
value2.description: AI-powered translation and automation that works seamlessly in the background.

value3.title: Inclusivity
value3.description: Every business deserves global reach, regardless of technical expertise or budget.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Launch your global business in three simple steps

step1.title: Customer Selects Language
step1.description: Your customers browse your menu in their preferred language. AI instantly translates everything - menu items, descriptions, prices.

step2.title: Choose Their Currency
step2.description: Customers see prices in their local currency. Real-time conversion handles all the calculations automatically.

step3.title: Order via WhatsApp
step3.description: Orders come directly to your WhatsApp. No app downloads needed for your customers. Simple and instant.
